name: Jairus' Daughter
title: The Raised Girl
summary: Jairus' daughter was a twelve-year-old girl who died but was raised to life by Jesus. Her healing is one of the most dramatic miracles in the Gospels and demonstrates Jesus' power over death.

keyEvents.title: The Father Asks Jesus for Help
keyEvents.description: Jairus, a synagogue leader, came to Jesus and earnestly asked him to come and lay his hands on his dying daughter.

keyEvents.title: The Message of Her Death
keyEvents.description: While Jesus was on his way, some from Jairus' house arrived and said that his daughter had died and there was no longer any need to trouble the teacher.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Encourages Faith
keyEvents.description: Jesus overheard the message and said to Jairus: 'Do not be afraid; only believe!' He did not want the father to lose hope.

keyEvents.title: Jesus raises her
keyEvents.description: Jesus went into the girl's room, took her by the hand and said 'Talita kumi', which means 'Little girl, I say to you: Get up!' Immediately she stood up and began to walk around.

keyEvents.title: Jesus asks for food for her
keyEvents.description: After the girl had gotten up, Jesus instructed that they should give her something to eat, confirming that she was truly alive again.
